question:
You are helping Driss, who runs a furniture workshop near Agadir. Here is what they told you, in their own order.
The workshop makes bookcases, cabinets and wardrobes.
Each of the bookcases needs 7 units of wood, 8 machine hours, and earns a profit of 27 dollars.
Each of the cabinets needs 3 units of wood, 1 machine hours, and earns a profit of 21 dollars.
The business was founded in 1979 in Fes and now employs 53 people.
Office rent is 4,300 dollars per month, paid whatever the plan.
Each of the wardrobes needs 6 units of wood, and earns a profit of 49 dollars.
The parking lot has 25 spaces, 4 of them reserved for visitors.
This week the workshop has 74 units of wood and 52 machine hours available.
Last year's total revenue was 8,470,000 dollars.
Everything produced will be sold, and only whole units can be made.
How many of each product should be made to maximise total profit?
answer_keys: The maximum total profit in dollars
objective_key: The maximum total profit in dollars
independent_check: brute force over every production plan
